scripts.build: pnpm run bundle && pnpm run grammars && pnpm run runtime
scripts.bundle: esbuild src/index.mts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/mybatis.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.grammars: mkdir -p dist/grammars && tree-sitter build --wasm -o dist/grammars/mybatis.wasm node_modules/tree-sitter-mybatis && tree-sitter build --wasm -o dist/grammars/java.wasm node_modules/tree-sitter-java
